landing.heroSub: Daily routines that keep coming back, stars kids actually want to earn, and rewards parents feel good about handing out. All in one bright, friendly app.
landing.finePrint: Works on your phone, tablet, and web. No ads. No tracking the kids.
landing.sectionHow: Three steps to a calmer morning

features.routinesText: Brush teeth, pack the bag, feed the dog. Set it once, and it shows up every morning, afternoon, or evening.
features.starsText: Each task is worth stars. Kids see them pile up. Progress bars fill. All done? Big celebration.
features.rewardsText: Set the prize list: ice cream, screen time, trip to the park. Kids ask, grown-ups say yes.
features.approvalText: Reward requests go to parents first. Approve with a tap. Stars only spend when you say so.
features.calendarText: Soccer, dentist, grandma's visit. Everyone sees the same week — no more surprise schedules.
features.multiKidText: Add every kid in the house. Each gets their own avatar, color, star balance, and progress.

steps.s1Text: Add the kids and the grown-ups. Pick fun avatars.
steps.s2Text: Add the tasks that come back each day, with stars to earn.
steps.s3Text: Kids tap Done, stars add up, rewards get traded. Everyone wins.

showcase.tasksH2: Kids see what to do today.
showcase.tasksText: Tasks are grouped by morning, afternoon, and evening — with a big tap-anywhere <1>Done!</1> button.
showcase.requestsText: Reward requests queue up in <1>Requests</1>. Approve or save for later with one tap.

landing.finalCtaTitle: Give it a try — your morning will thank you.
landing.finalCtaText: Free to start. Takes about 2 minutes to set up. Works on any device your family already has.
